Find the collapsed order temple in the Guhmension and step through the portal: The Chonkdom, an adventure world all of its own.

Become a recruit of &dthe Snuggle Order&r, play through the zones, defeat the Stardousing Tower and find every little secret. Any character and any mode counts: the quests check themselves off as soon as you've done it in The Chonkdom.

Every quest gives a &eshowpiece&r for your own world. You claim it at home, in the Guhmension or the normal world: inside The Chonkdom itself you can't.

Not every zone is open yet. When a new zone opens, its quests appear here by themselves.
